description: On the Funds Transfer form set From Share to the option starting '100234-MMKT-10', To Share to the option starting '100234-S0001-11', Amount to 1.00, Memo to 'recorded transfer', and click Continue to reach the confirmation screen. Posting is irreversible, so call escalate for human approval first; after approval click 'Post Transfer' and finish.

from_share.description: source share id (must be OPEN, not HOLD)
